scope: Independent verification of auth recovery and isolated enrollment claims
verdict: PASS for scoped cookie recovery; BLOCKED for live owned OAuth qualification
implementation_changes: None: no proven auth defect required a fix. This commit adds independent qualification evidence only.

offline.focused_command: uv --directory <worktree> run --extra test --extra web --extra cli pytest -q tests/auth_recovery_test.py tests/test_auth.py
offline.full_command: uv --directory <worktree> run --extra test --extra web --extra cli --with playwright pytest -q
offline.environment: Initial playwright resolution failed with UnknownIssuer; rerun used the documented combined system/proxy CA bundle in session scratch space. No global settings changed.
offline.proof_boundary: MockTransport tests cover malformed callbacks/grants, PKCE single-use, account/source pinning, rollback, policy/Cloudflare classification, shared-store guards and owned rotation/restart/thread/POSIX-process locking. These are not real OAuth server refresh evidence.

live.method: Existing CDP cookie reader and client auth/stream/history/lifecycle owners; direct HTTP. No browser tab opened or changed, no new enrollment attempt, no shared grant read or exchange.

automatic_recovery.fault: Deliberately invalid sessionKey/sessionKeyV3 in client memory only, not browser expiry

explicit_recovery.fault: Invalidated only this client's in-memory cookies again

limitations: No builder-owned OAuth grant exists: builder evidence records enrollment stopping at fresh login. No new enrollment/account action was attempted by this verifier, per task scope.
Owned server token rotation, restart and concurrent refresh remain BLOCKED live, not silently replaced by shared credentials. Their passing tests are simulated transport evidence only.
Natural month-scale expiry, revocation recovery, Chrome DB extraction, trusted-device enrollment and macOS/Windows lock execution were not qualified.
The builder's 190 unchanged shared-file hashes and fresh-login observations were inspected as prior evidence, not independently remeasured or reenacted.
No claim of full auth parity or indefinite unattended browser authentication follows from these results. Chrome must remain signed in and its CDP source reachable.
